panels.title: Now: can I trust these numbers?
Data age
panels.description:
Definition: time since the newest engine scan that finished ok or partial. Every 'now' number on this page is as of that scan. Green within 15 min (3 scans), orange within 1 h, red beyond.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(finished_at)) AS "Data age"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Known state
panels.description:
Definition: share of all GPUs in the ledger now whose state is known (not UNKNOWN). Below 90% many totals elsewhere are lower bounds; the tables below say why.
Filters: site.
The label gives the UNKNOWN GPUs and all GPUs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN sum(i.gpus) > 0
            THEN 100.0 * coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category <> 'UNKNOWN'), 0) / sum(i.gpus) END AS "Known",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) || ' of '
       || coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) || ' GPUs unknown' AS label
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))

panels.title: Failing sources
panels.description:
Definition: sources (server-scan, each cluster's kube API and Thanos) whose latest read failed or that never succeeded, plus configured collector managers with no complete read within 1 h (TTV_COLLECTOR_STALE_AFTER default; a manager removed from TTV_MANAGERS_FILE no longer counts). 0 = every source answered on its latest attempt. The tables below name them.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT manager, kind, added_at AS since FROM collector_managers WHERE removed_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.manager, min(r.kind), min(r.started_at) FROM collector_reads r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collector_managers m WHERE m.manager = r.manager)
  GROUP BY r.manager
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM source_state WHERE failed_scans > 0 OR last_success_at IS NULL)
     + (SELECT count(*) FROM active a
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collector_reads r
                          WHERE r.manager = a.manager AND r.complete
                            AND r.finished_at >= now() - interval '1 hour')) AS "Failing sources"
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_state)

panels.title: Identity conflicts
panels.description:
Definition: open rows in identity_conflicts (two records claiming one asset, two assets claiming one node, ambiguous collector profiles). Their GPUs are UNKNOWN (IDENTITY_CONFLICT) until resolved; the table below lists them.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Open conflicts" FROM identity_conflicts WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

panels.title: Price data age
panels.description:
Definition: days since the AWS price list behind the engine's selected snapshot (TTV_PRICING_SNAPSHOT, else the latest published) was published; the line above the value names its region and date. Orange after 90 days, red after 180: capture a new snapshot (ADR-0003).
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.* FROM pricing_snapshots p
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = p.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, p.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, p.captured_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - publication_date) / 86400 AS days,
       region || ', ' || to_char(publication_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label
FROM s

panels.title: Source health (source_state)
panels.description:
Definition: engine-side health per source (server-scan, each target cluster, collector targets): consecutive failed scans, last success, last attempt and last error.
Units: counts; timestamps in the dashboard timezone; time since success as duration.
State: 'ok' (green) = last fetch succeeded; 'failing, within grace' (orange) = 1 consecutive failure; 'beyond grace: assets UNKNOWN' (red) = 2 or more, the default unknown_grace_scans, at which the engine turns the source's assets UNKNOWN; 'never succeeded' (purple) = no complete fetch yet. Thresholds assume the default grace; change the SQL if the policy changes it.
Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: 'never' = the source has not completed a fetch since the engine started tracking it; its assets are UNKNOWN, not empty.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Source",
       CASE WHEN last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'never succeeded'
            WHEN failed_scans = 0 THEN 'ok'
            WHEN failed_scans < 2 THEN 'failing, within grace'
            ELSE 'beyond grace: assets UNKNOWN' END AS "State",
       failed_scans AS "Consecutive failed scans",
       last_success_at AS "Last success",
       extract(epoch FROM now() - last_success_at) AS "Since last success",
       last_attempt_at AS "Last attempt",
       last_error AS "Last error"
FROM source_state
ORDER BY (last_success_at IS NULL) DESC, failed_scans DESC, name

panels.title: Profile-less collector: managers
panels.description:
Definition: one row per UCS Central / OpenManage manager in TTV_MANAGERS_FILE, or read by the collector and not since removed from it (ADR-0004). State: never read; ok; latest read incomplete (no server can be retired); stale (no complete read within 1 h, the TTV_COLLECTOR_STALE_AFTER default: its collector-only servers are UNKNOWN); never complete. Counts come from the latest complete read: servers listed, servers with GPUs, servers whose GPU inventory could not be read, servers whose profile binding is ambiguous.
Empty = no manager configured (TTV_MANAGERS_FILE) or the collector has not run.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT manager, kind, added_at AS since FROM collector_managers WHERE removed_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.manager, min(r.kind), min(r.started_at) FROM collector_reads r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collector_managers m WHERE m.manager = r.manager)
  GROUP BY r.manager
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (manager) manager, finished_at, complete, errors
  FROM collector_reads ORDER BY manager, finished_at DESC, id DESC
), ok AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (manager) manager, id, finished_at
  FROM collector_reads WHERE complete ORDER BY manager, finished_at DESC, id DESC
), srv AS (
  SELECT read_id, count(*) AS servers,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_array_length(gpu_models) > 0) AS gpu_servers,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE gpu_models IS NULL) AS unread,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE profile_unresolved IS NOT NULL) AS unresolved
  FROM collector_servers GROUP BY read_id
)
SELECT a.manager AS "Manager",
       a.kind AS "Kind",
       CASE WHEN l.manager IS NULL THEN 'never read'
            WHEN ok.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'never complete'
            WHEN now() - ok.finished_at > interval '1 hour' THEN 'stale: servers UNKNOWN'
            WHEN NOT l.complete THEN 'latest read incomplete'
            ELSE 'ok' END AS "State",
       ok.finished_at AS "Last complete read",
       s.servers AS "Servers",
       s.gpu_servers AS "GPU servers",
       s.unread AS "GPUs unread",
       s.unresolved AS "Profile unresolved",
       jsonb_array_length(l.errors) AS "Errors (latest read)",
       l.errors ->> 0 AS "First error"
FROM active a
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.manager = a.manager
LEFT JOIN ok ON ok.manager = a.manager
LEFT JOIN srv s ON s.read_id = ok.id
ORDER BY 1

defaults.noValue: no manager read yet (TTV_MANAGERS_FILE unset or ttv-collector not running)

panels.title: Unknown GPUs now, by reason
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) and distinct assets of open UNKNOWN intervals, by reason_code (SOURCE_STALE, IDENTITY_CONFLICT, CONTESTED, CLUSTER_NOT_OBSERVED, ...).
Units: physical GPUs; assets.
Filters: site.
Unknown vs zero: '(none)' with 0 = the latest scan has no UNKNOWN GPUs in scope; 'No ledger data yet' = no open intervals at all. UNKNOWN GPUs are never counted as idle, productive or zero. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT i.reason_code, sum(i.gpus) AS gpus, count(DISTINCT i.asset_id) AS assets
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'UNKNOWN'
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  GROUP BY i.reason_code
)
SELECT reason_code AS "Reason", gpus AS "UNKNOWN GPUs", assets AS "Assets" FROM u
UNION ALL
SELECT '(none)', 0, 0
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
              WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)))
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Assets by source
panels.description:
Definition: assets in the ledger by the source that first registered them (server-scan, profile-less collector, ...): asset count, GPUs per inventory (assets.gpu_count), assets whose GPU count is unread, newest observation and assets not observed in the last hour.
Units: assets; GPUs; timestamps in the dashboard timezone.
Filters: site.
Unknown vs zero: assets with an unread GPU count are excluded from 'GPUs (inventory)' and counted in their own column, never as 0 GPUs. 'Not seen > 1 h' may be listing lag or a removed asset; a partial listing never closes intervals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(a.source, '(none)') AS "Source",
       count(*) AS "Assets",
       sum(a.gpu_count) AS "GPUs (inventory)",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.gpu_count IS NULL) AS "GPU count unread",
       max(a.last_observed_at) AS "Last observed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.last_observed_at < now() - interval '1 hour') AS "Not seen > 1 h"
FROM assets a
WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Open identity conflicts
panels.description:
Definition: unresolved identity_conflicts, oldest first: conflict kind, contested key, candidate source records, first and last seen.
Units: timestamps in the dashboard timezone; open-for as duration.
Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: an empty table means no open conflict; resolved conflicts keep their history in the ledger but are not shown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "Kind",
       key AS "Key",
       jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidates) = 'array' THEN candidates ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS "Candidates (n)",
       (SELECT string_agg(c, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
          CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidates) = 'array' THEN candidates ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS c) AS "Candidates",
       first_seen AS "First seen",
       extract(epoch FROM now() - first_seen) AS "Open for"
FROM identity_conflicts
WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
ORDER BY first_seen, kind, key

panels.title: Selected period: scans and coverage over time
Engine scans per hour, by result
panels.description:
Definition: engine scans started in each hour of the time range, stacked by result (ok, partial, failed). A gap means no scan ran: check the engine. Partial = some source failed and its assets kept their last state or turned UNKNOWN after grace.
Filters: time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1h'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS "ok",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'partial') AS "partial",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS "failed"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status IN ('ok', 'partial', 'failed')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Every GPU by category over time
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs in each category at each point in the time range, sampled from the ledger and stacked, so the top line is all GPUs. A growing purple band means evidence is being lost. The chart starts at the first engine scan.
Filters: site, time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()),
                         make_interval(secs => greatest($__interval_ms, 300000) / 1000.0)) AS t
), iv AS (
  SELECT t.t, i.category, i.gpus
  FROM t
  JOIN capacity_intervals i ON i.started_at <= t.t AND (i.ended_at IS NULL OR i.ended_at > t.t)
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
)
SELECT t.t AS time,
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS "Productive",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS "Idle",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.category = 'NOT_CHARGED'), 0) AS "Not charged",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS "Unknown"
FROM t
LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = t.t
WHERE t.t >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial'))
GROUP BY t.t
ORDER BY t.t

panels.title: Recent partial or failed scans
panels.description:
Definition: newest 20 scan_runs in the time range whose status is partial or failed, with their recorded errors and coverage.
Units: timestamps in the dashboard timezone.
Filters: time range.
Unknown vs zero: an empty table means no partial or failed scan started in the range; check 'Scan runs over time' for gaps where no scan ran at all.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS "Started",
       kind AS "Kind",
       status AS "Status",
       extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at) AS "Duration",
       (SELECT string_agg(e, '; ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
          CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(errors) = 'array' THEN errors ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS e) AS "Errors"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status IN ('partial', 'failed') AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 20

defaults.noValue: no partial or failed scans in the time range
